art.subject: Brown Shrike of the race confusus (Lanius cristatus confusus), adult male, as seen in Korea on spring passage in May: forehead white, the white band broad and running back into a white supercilium; crown, nape, mantle and back plain pale grey-brown, the crown the same tone as the back, neither grey nor rufous; rump and long tail warmer rufous-brown; a bold black mask from the bill base through the eye over the ear-coverts; cheeks, chin and throat white; underparts white with a pale buff wash on the breast sides and flanks; wings dark brown with pale brown fringes and no white patch. Stout black hooked bill; dark eye; dark grey legs.
art.pose: perched upright on top of a shrub, scanning the ground for insects, side view
art.scene: Korean island scrub and field edge with shrubs in May, during spring passage, fresh green leaves; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view perched on a twig: broad white forehead joining a white supercilium, black mask through the eye over the ear-coverts, plain pale grey-brown crown and back of one tone, rufous-brown rump and long graduated tail, white throat and underparts with buff flanks, plain brown wings without a white patch, black hooked bill, dark legs
adult male, head in profile: broad white forehead band running into a long white supercilium above the black mask, pale grey-brown crown, white cheeks and throat, stout black hooked bill
adult female, side view perched: like the male but duller, the mask dark brown rather than black, fine dark crescent barring on the buff breast sides and flanks
art.build: Medium-small shrike, clearly larger and longer-tailed than a sparrow and a little smaller than a Brown-eared Bulbul; sits upright on exposed twigs and wires with the tail hanging down. Large rounded head on a short thick neck, no crest. Bill black, stout and deep, shorter than the head, the upper mandible ending in a strong hook. Legs short, dark grey, with strong toes. Wings short and rounded: at rest the wingtips reach only just past the base of the tail. Tail long, narrow and graduated, rounded at the tip.
art.basis: 형태: 국내외 종 설명 교차 확인(출처 목록) · tools/ART_RULES.md
avoid: Do not paint a clean pale grey crown contrasting with a browner back; that marks the race lucionensis. In confusus the crown is grey-brown like the back.
Do not paint warm rufous-chestnut crown and upperparts; those mark the nominate race cristatus and superciliosus.
Do not add a white patch at the base of the primaries (Bull-headed Shrike, Lanius bucephalus).
Do not paint chestnut upperparts with black scalloping (Tiger Shrike) or a straight bill without a hook.
